class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/bench-harbor.yml` line 776

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-18):
# Submission-mode ATIF gate failure does not prevent the hub upload

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

> hard failure in submission mode (an un-submittable job must not burn hub quota either)

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

```yaml
      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        id: atif_gate
        if: always()
        ...
      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub
        # gh-1681: in submission mode a failed ATIF gate must skip the
        # upload (the job is un-submittable — no hub quota burn).
        if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != '' && (inputs.submission != true || steps.atif_gate.outcome == 'success')
```

(`SubmissionPreflightWiringTest.test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload` asserts ordering only, which is why the `if:` interplay slipped through — extend it to pin the upload condition.)

---

### Thread 2 — `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` line 507

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-18):
# Include stderr in the export-failure warning tail

💡 **SUGGESTION**

On a non-zero export exit the warning prints the last 200 chars of `result.stdout` only. The headless `fa` CLI writes its diagnostics to **stderr** (`_TerminalCliIO.writeln` routes to stderr in headless mode; the ATIF document itself is the only stdout payload — see `bin/fah_trajectory.dart`). A failed export will therefore almost always produce an empty or misleading tail here, leaving the shard log with a warning that says nothing about *why* the leaderboard-critical trajectory is missing.

```python
tail = ((result.stdout or "") + (result.stderr or ""))[-200:]
```

(same for the `except` branch if the exception carries stderr).

---

### Thread 3 — `bench/harbor_fa/test_atif_contract.py` line 17

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-18):
# Unused imports (shutil, sys)

💡 **SUGGESTION**

`shutil` and `sys` are imported but never referenced in this module — drop them (the neighboring bench tests run under strict lint gates in some lanes; unused imports are the kind of nit those gates flag).

---


## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-18):

# Submission-mode ATIF gate failure does not prevent the hub upload

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

> hard failure in submission mode (an un-submittable job must not burn hub quota either)

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

```yaml
      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        id: atif_gate
        if: always()
        ...
      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub
        # gh-1681: in submission mode a failed ATIF gate must skip the
        # upload (the job is un-submittable — no hub quota burn).
        if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != '' && (inputs.submission != true || steps.atif_gate.outcome == 'success')
```

(`SubmissionPreflightWiringTest.test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload` asserts ordering only, which is why the `if:` interplay slipped through — extend it to pin the upload condition.)

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from

  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under

  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

    def test_export_failure_is_loud_but_never_fails_the_trial(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(
            launch_delay=0.05, export_error=RuntimeError("fa export wedged")
        )
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):

                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())

- Commit subjects: `type(scope): ...` (`feat:`, `fix:`, `fix(example):`,

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

        if: always()

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

        agent = FakeAgent(

        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):

        self.assertIn("leaderboard static analysis", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

          shopt -s nullglob

          for result in "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/bench/jobs/${JOB_NAME}"/*/result.json; do
            total=$((total + 1))
            trial_dir=$(dirname "$result")
            if [ ! -f "$trial_dir/agent/trajectory.json" ]; then

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the

  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"
            # fa headless writes its diagnostics to stderr (stdout carries
            # only the ATIF payload) — the warning tail must surface them.
            stderr = "fatal: session store corrupt"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("fatal: session store corrupt", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_failure_warning_includes_exception_stderr(self):
        # The except branch: when the raised failure carries a stderr
        # payload (harbor's exec errors do), the warning must surface it —
        # a bare exception string leaves the shard log blind to why the
        # leaderboard-critical trajectory is missing.
        self._knob_env()
        exc = RuntimeError("Command failed (exit 1)")
        exc.stderr = "stack trace from fa"
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05, export_error=exc)
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export failed", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("stack trace from fa", err.getvalue())

  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        id: atif_gate
        if: always()

      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        id: atif_gate
        if: always()

      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class _ExecResult:
    def __init__(self, stdout=""):
        self.return_code = 0
        self.stdout = stdout


class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)

            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:

            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

        id: atif_gate
        if: always()

      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1].split("permissions:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", block)
        self.assertIn("default: false", block)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class FakeAgent(fa_agent.FaAgent):
    """FaAgent with scripted exec_as_agent/exec_as_root.

    The agent launch hangs until the kill lands (fa dying on SIGTERM); the
    kill sets `killed` even when scripted to fail — the pre-fix bug was the
    pkill's OWN exit-143 propagating, not fa surviving. `launch_delay`
    turns the launch into a natural completion after that many seconds,
    and `counter` makes the progress samples grow (gh-1576 checkpoints).
    """

    def __init__(self, fail_pkill=False, launch_delay=None, counter=None,
                 launch_error=None, ignore_kill=False, pgrep_alive=False,
                 export_error=None):
        self._version = None
        self.fail_pkill = fail_pkill
        self.launch_delay = launch_delay
        self.launch_error = launch_error
        self.counter = counter
        # gh-1589: fa wedged ignoring SIGTERM/SIGKILL (the reap-timeout
        # shape), and whether pgrep still reports the process alive.
        self.ignore_kill = ignore_kill
        self.pgrep_alive = pgrep_alive
        # gh-1681 Gap 2: the ATIF export exec scripted to fail.
        self.export_error = export_error
        self.launch_exited = False
        self.root_calls = []
        self.agent_calls = []
        # gh-1681: one unified, cross-channel order log (agent + root
        # execs interleave in production; the per-channel lists alone
        # cannot express "the export ran after the kill").
        self.exec_log = []
        self.launch_env = None
        self.killed = None
        self.audit_payload = None
        self.audit_payloads = []

    async def exec_as_root(self, environment, command=None, timeout_sec=None, env=None):
        self.root_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "pkill" in command:
            if not self.ignore_kill:
                self.killed.set()
            if self.fail_pkill:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Command failed (exit 143): pkill -f 'fa --session-root' || true"
                )
            return _ExecResult()
        if "pgrep" in command:
            # gh-1589 reap poll: exit 0 = process gone, 3 = still alive.
            if self.pgrep_alive:
                alive = _ExecResult("alive")
                alive.return_code = 3
                return alive
            return _ExecResult()
        return _ExecResult()

    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
        self.agent_calls.append(command)
        self.exec_log.append(command)
        if "trajectory export" in command:
            if self.export_error is not None:
                raise self.export_error
            return _ExecResult()
        if _AGENT_LAUNCH_SNIPPET in command:
            self.launch_env = env
            self.killed = asyncio.Event()
            if self.launch_error is not None:
                # The crashed-exec shape (e.g. harbor's
                # NonZeroAgentExitCodeError after a non-zero fa exit).
                self.launch_exited = True
                raise self.launch_error

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-18):
# Submission-mode ATIF gate failure does not prevent the hub upload

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**

The new "Preflight ATIF trajectories" step fails hard in submission mode (`exit 1` below), but the very next step — **Upload to Harbor Hub** — runs under `if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''`. `always()` includes steps whose predecessors failed, so when the ATIF gate catches a missing `agent/trajectory.json` and fails the shard, the upload **still runs**: the un-submittable job is pushed to the hub anyway, burning hub quota — exactly what this step's own comment says the hard failure prevents:

> hard failure in submission mode (an un-submittable job must not burn hub quota either)

The gate therefore only marks the shard red; it does not gate the upload. Suggested fix — give the gate an id and tighten the upload condition:

```yaml
      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        id: atif_gate
        if: always()
        ...
      - name: Upload to Harbor Hub
        # gh-1681: in submission mode a failed ATIF gate must skip the
        # upload (the job is un-submittable — no hub quota burn).
        if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != '' && (inputs.submission != true || steps.atif_gate.outcome == 'success')
```

(`SubmissionPreflightWiringTest.test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload` asserts ordering only, which is why the `if:` interplay slipped through — extend it to pin the upload condition.)

# Include stderr in the export-failure warning tail

💡 **SUGGESTION**

The headless `fa` CLI writes its diagnostics to **stderr** (`_TerminalCliIO.writeln` routes to stderr in headless mode; the ATIF document itself is the only stdout payload — see `bin/fah_trajectory.dart`). A failed export will therefore almost always produce an empty or misleading tail here, leaving the shard log with a warning that says nothing about *why* the leaderboard-critical trajectory is missing.
